requirement: Cursor current login/source proof coherence and fidelity of official CLI usage display
scope: normal native Settings UI with real Cursor subscription
nonGoals: all new subscription tiers and other operating systems
environment: normal existing macOS CLI HOME, network and existing trusted workspace; no environment or credential overrides
build: Committed external clone; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; APFS clone of previous external release cache; archive copied bundle before building; ordinary Tauri release with unique id and native data path, ephemeral WebView; local ad-hoc bundle signing codesign --force --sign - --timestamp=none; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
acceptance: Cursor authenticated source proof and header/account are consistent; historical quota alone never establishes login
explicit signed-out status is not overridden by old quota
official CLI panel and Tokage retain each allocation and reported precision; do not add Included/Auto/API or infer money or request counts
source/config invalidation cannot replay old proof
cache survives normal restart as historical until revalidated
no model prompt, auto verification or new workspace trust
limits: Local signed isolation build differs from official release binary
Ephemeral WebView does not certify all frontend-setting persistence
Only currently installed CLI and this account; vendor-rounded percentages are not exact request/dollar balances
Transport fault recovery is covered offline; do not inject failures into the real app
stopping: Stop on unanticipated model request, credential/account change or trust confirmation; retain every failed attempt
